_doc: Background bed (client request, cue amb:bed f0-480): two real Mixkit ambiences on the amb bus. Body: 'Wind in the top of the mountain' (steady wind, per-second RMS -21..-23 dBFS, crest 10-13 dB: no bumps), high-passed so it sits as air above the music's low end. Air: 'Desert ambience' (rolloff 8.6 kHz, per-second RMS -38..-40 in the window used) as the airy top layer for the star dust. Present in the 0-2 s intro, then ridden down to sit about 10-14 dB under the music, fading with the ring-out.
_rides_doc: v2: first pass measured the bed 1 dB under the music in 0-2 s and 10 dB under after 2 s; now -1 dB in the intro and -6/-5 dB from the 2.0 downbeat (about 12 dB under the music)
